assessment: This manuscript investigates the humoral neutralizing antibody and cellular immune responses of volunteers in a randomized clinical trial for the CoronaVac SARS-CoV-2 vaccine. The findings are useful and provide context for the efficaciousness of the 0-14 day and 0-28 day dosing schedules of CoronaVac. The results show that these two dosing schedules are similar across most metrics.
